response.query: What legal review outcomes will gate synthetic-account audits, and what contingency audit alternatives (platform partnerships, passive designs, data donations) will we commit to if prohibited?
response.answer: Legal review outcomes will likely restrict synthetic-account audits; contingency alternatives include platform partnerships, passive designs, and data donations. If prohibited, we will commit to these alternatives to maintain compliance.
